resolutions.researcher_notes: Egypt Oil & Gas 'The Western Desert: Egypt's Giant Petroleum Reservoir' report (2020) lists Salam-Matruh Terminal in its 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' table (existing built infrastructure), which supports an operating status. url_verifier returns HTTP 200 but flags 'Salam' missing because the PDF text stream is compressed; verified via local pdftotext that the row exists (Salam-Matruh Terminal | Salam | Matruh | 75 | 10 | 22). Status 'operating' is implied by inclusion in the existing-infrastructure table, not explicitly stated. Single source; no independent corroboration found.

Salam-Matruh appears under 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' with capacity in mmcf/d, directly supporting Fuel=Gas (natural gas). Verified via pdftotext (compressed PDF stream defeats url_verifier substring check). Single source.

PDF pipeline table Capacity (mmcf/d) column reads 22 for the Salam-Matruh row, exactly matching Capacity=22.00 MMcf/d. Verified via pdftotext. Single source; no second independent source located for this spec.
PDF pipeline table Length (Km) column reads 75 for the Salam-Matruh row, matching LengthKnown=75.00 km. Verified via pdftotext. Single source.
PDF pipeline table Diameter (Inches) column reads 10 for the Salam-Matruh row, matching Diameter=10.00 in. Verified via pdftotext. Single source.

The FuelSource cell value is itself this Egypt Oil & Gas PDF URL (a data-entry quirk), so the ref is self-referential: the PDF is the document backing the FuelSource entry. URL returns HTTP 200; content verified present via pdftotext.

PDF pipeline table lists From=Salam, To=Matruh for this line, supporting StartLocation=Salam and EndPrefecture/District=Matruh Terminal. Salam field and Matruh City are both in the northern Western Desert (PDF text: Matruh City in the northern Western Desert), consistent with StartState=Western Desert / EndState=Matruh, StartCountry/EndCountry=Egypt. Verified via pdftotext. Single source.

CONTRADICTION FLAG: no source supports Owner1='General Petroleum Co' (GPC) for this pipeline. The Egypt Oil & Gas PDF names GPC only in connection with a gas/condensate plant at Abu Sennan and the SOUTHERN Western Desert fields; it does not attribute the (northern) Salam-Matruh pipeline to GPC. Independent sources (Offshore Technology, Oil & Gas Journal, APA/Apache) establish that the Salam field sits in the Khalda Concession, operated by Khalda Petroleum Company (Apache + EGPC JV) — not General Petroleum Company. GPC and EGPC are distinct entities. Owner value appears mis-attributed; recommend Update review rather than a fabricated ref. Left UNRESOLVED per no-fabrication rule.
